title: Paul Graham (Y Combinator co-founder) — 'Other leadership books for founders only let you get to third base'
summary: Paul Graham — Y Combinator co-founder, Lisp essayist, and one of the most influential voices in the founder world (4.9M followers on X) — replies to an Eric endorsement drop with a signature-Graham compliment: implying every other leadership book for founders only makes it to third base while Incorruptible hits a home run.
blockquote: Other leadership books for founders only let you get to third base.
